title: RIDE-Splat: Reflection Removal for In-the-Wild Driving Environments
abstract: arXiv:2610.34632v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Driving video captured through a windshield violates the world-space consistency assumed by 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS): the road scene exhibits parallax while cabin reflections remain attached to the camera, causing standard 3DGS to embed reflected content into the reconstructed scene. We introduce RIDE-Splat, a pipeline for reflection-free 3D reconstruction from posed driving video without clean images, reflection masks, or pretrained networks. RIDE-Splat assigns world-consistent transmission through the windshield to a 3DGS scene and the dominant camera-attached reflection to one shared, signed RGB image. It builds the clean reconstruction in two passes. First, it learns the 3D geometry and the signed reflection image, representing both added radiance and transmission attenuation. Then, it uses the reflection-removed training images to fit a clean 3DGS model. At inference, the reflection image is discarded, preserving the standard

translated_title: RIDE-Splat：面向真实世界驾驶环境的反射去除
translated_abstract: 通过挡风玻璃拍摄的驾驶视频违反了三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）所假设的世界空间一致性：道路场景呈现视差，而车内反射则始终附着于相机，导致标准3DGS将反射内容嵌入到重建的场景中。我们提出RIDE-Splat，一个从带位姿的驾驶视频中进行无反射三维重建的流水线，无需干净图像、反射掩码或预训练网络。RIDE-Splat将通过挡风玻璃的世界一致性透射分配给3DGS场景，并将主要的相机附着反射分配给一张共享的带符号RGB图像。它分两个阶段构建干净的重建：首先，学习三维几何和带符号反射图像，同时表示附加辐射和透射衰减；然后，使用去除反射后的训练图像拟合一个干净的3DGS模型。在推理时，反射图像被丢弃，从而保持标准的（原文此处不完整）……
tldr: 提出RIDE-Splat流水线，通过将道路场景的世界一致性透射与附着于相机的挡风玻璃反射分离建模为一张共享的带符号RGB图像，从带位姿的驾驶视频实现无反射的三维高斯泼溅重建，无需干净图像、反射掩码或预训练网络。
en_tdlr: RIDE-Splat is a pipeline that achieves reflection-free 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstruction from posed driving videos by separating world-consistent road-scene transmission from camera-attached windshield reflections modeled as a shared signed RGB image, without requiring clean images, reflection masks, or pretrained networks.
